title: The app garden grew into a proper study and planning shelf
summary:
A community harvest: new learning, creative, gaming, and companion apps landed alongside a more self-hosting-friendly MCP server.

Learn gained Pollen Scope, Pollination EduCard AI, and Studdy for study cards, guides, flashcards, and quizzes. The catalog also picked up AI Blog Articles for quick no-signup drafts, Briefly for turning notes into plans, Promptzy for keeping prompts findable, and Valdy for putting startup ideas through a reality check before they consume a month of weekends.

Creative tooling expanded with Silenos Música for song and sound generation, two video tools for translation and creation, and new image apps including a French-language generator plus GIMP bridges for generating skies and images inside familiar art workflows. FluxFlow CLI and AIOPE Headless also bring Pollinations-powered generation into terminal and self-hosted assistant setups.

Bots now include HSCAura and Lucia, while 7visions offers structured dream exploration through seven perspectives. On the games side, Archetype lets small groups build stories with nova-fast and NEON SHADOWS adds an AI-driven RPG. This is what happens when an API gets left near creative people.
